7513.title: Title-bar sizing leaks into tab affordances
7513.rootCauseOneLine: Desktop height normalization reaches close controls; plain sidebar overlays and width-toggling arrows mismatch the framed tab viewport.
7513.proposedFix: Exclude close controls from title-bar sizing, reserve overflow slots, and alpha-mask tab edges over transparent arrows.
7513.caveats: Verified in two clean source checkouts using Chromium; no packaged macOS/WebKit smoke test.
